reason: Both describe the identical runtime mechanism: the comment-strip regex executes before html.unescape, so entity-encoded comment delimiters (e.g. <!-- -->) aren't literal <!-- --> at strip time, pass through unmatched, and (once unescaped) reach group_broken_paragraphs as literal HTML comments — reproducing the exact shredding-into-noise failure the step was meant to prevent. The reviewer frames this via the mismatched comments documenting the reversed order, but the causal chain and failure scenario it states (wrong order → entity-encoded markers unstripped → fall through to group_broken_paragraphs) is the same defect, not a different bug.
